ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Green consumers, compared with non-green consumers, prefer purchasing environmentally-friendly products over the standard alternatives available. Green consumers believe that they are guided by their internal control and open-mindedness, so they would not leave the responsibilities of protecting the environment to governments, business communities, environmentalists or scientists. Green consumers are ordinary people thinking that business operations have a vital role in fighting to protect environment in general. Moreover, these consumers believe that an individual's consumption makes a difference in environmental issues. When green consumers demand products and services, firms combine environmental and social costs of their production and consumption. They also provide green management and green marketing practices by creating job opportunities in green consumption. Therefore, it could be said that green consumers are individuals targeting sustainability by using their purchasing power.

Green consumers are ordinary people thinking that business operations have a vital role in fighting to protect environment in general. Moreover, these consumers believe that an individual's consumption ③<u>makes</u> a difference in environmental issues. When green consumers demand products and services, firms combine environmental and social costs of their production and consumption. They also provide green management and green marketing practices by creating job opportunities in green consumption. Therefore, it could be ④<u>saying</u> that green consumers are individuals targeting sustainability by using their purchasing power.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ saying → said (수동태 과거분사)
det.analysis:
✅ ① prefer(S1): 주어 consumers(복수)에 동사 원형 적합
✅ ② believe(S2): 주어 consumers(복수)에 동사 원형 적합
✅ ③ makes(S4): 주어 consumption(단수)에 3인칭 단수 동사 적합
❌ ④ saying → said(S7): 'it could be said that ~'에서 가주어 구문의 수동태이므로 과거분사 said가 필요. saying(능동)은 부적절
det.tip: 가주어 it + be + p.p.: it could be said that ~(~라고 말해질 수 있다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① comparing → compared (관용 분사구문)
det.analysis:
❌ ① comparing → compared(S1): 'compared with ~'는 관용적 분사구문으로 과거분사 compared가 올바름. comparing with는 비표준 ←정답
✅ ② responsibilities(S2): 복수 명사로 the 뒤에 적절
✅ ③ thinking(S3): people을 수식하는 현재분사 후치수식으로 적절
✅ ④ provide(S6): 주어 They(복수)에 동사 원형 적합
det.tip: compared with/to ~(~와 비교하여)는 관용 분사구문. comparing은 비표준.

Green consumers believe that they are guided by their internal control and open-mindedness, so they would not ②<u>leave</u> the responsibilities of protecting the environment to governments, business communities, environmentalists or scientists. When green consumers demand products and services, firms combine environmental and social costs of their production and consumption. They also provide green management and green marketing practices by creating job opportunities in green consumption. Therefore, ③<u>that</u> could be said that green consumers are individuals targeting sustainability by using their purchasing ④<u>power</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ that → it (가주어 it 필수)
det.analysis:
✅ ① purchasing(S1): 동명사로 prefer의 목적어 적절
✅ ② leave(S2): 조동사 would 뒤 원형부정사로 적절
❌ ③ that → it(S7): 'it could be said that...'에서 it은 가주어. that으로 바꾸면 이중 that 비문 ←정답
✅ ④ power(S7): 명사로 purchasing power(구매력) 구성에 적절
det.tip: 가주어 it: it could be said that S+V (진주어). it을 that/this로 바꿀 수 없다.

Green consumers believe that they are guided by their internal control and ②<u>open-mindedness</u>, so they would not leave the responsibilities of protecting the environment to governments, business communities, environmentalists or scientists. Green consumers are ③<u>exceptional</u> people thinking that business operations have a vital role in fighting to protect environment in general. Moreover, these consumers believe that an individual's consumption makes a difference in environmental issues. When green consumers demand products and services, firms combine environmental and ④<u>social</u> costs of their production and consumption. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ exceptional(뛰어난) → ordinary(평범한)
det.analysis:
✅ ① environmentally-friendly(S1): 친환경 제품이라는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② open-mindedness(S2): 내적 통제와 함께 '열린 마음'이라는 문맥에 적절
❌ ③ exceptional → ordinary(S3): 녹색 소비자는 '평범한' 사람들이라고 해야 전문가가 아닌 일반인이라는 논지에 부합
✅ ④ social(S5): 환경적·'사회적' 비용이라는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: ordinary people(평범한 사람들)은 녹색 소비자가 전문가가 아닌 보통 사람임을 강조한다.

questions.passage: Green consumers, compared with non-green consumers, prefer purchasing environmentally-friendly products over the standard alternatives available. Green consumers believe that they are guided by their internal control and open-mindedness, so they would not ①<u>assign</u> the responsibilities of protecting the environment to governments, business communities, environmentalists or scientists. Green consumers are ordinary people thinking that business operations have a vital role in fighting to protect environment in ②<u>general</u>. Moreover, these consumers believe that an individual's consumption makes a ③<u>difference</u> in environmental issues. When green consumers demand products and ④<u>services</u>, firms combine environmental and social costs of their production and consumption. They also provide green management and green marketing practices by creating job opportunities in green consumption. Therefore, it could be said that green consumers are individuals targeting sustainability by using their purchasing power.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① assign(배정하다) → leave(맡기다, 떠넘기다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① assign → leave(S2): 'would not leave the responsibilities to governments'에서 leave는 '떠넘기다'의 의미. assign(배정하다)은 의도적이고 공식적인 위임을 뜻하지만, leave는 무책임하게 '떠넘기다'는 부정적 뉘앙스. 원문의 'would not'과 결합하면 '맡기지 않겠다'는 의지 표현에 leave가 적합 ←정답
✅ ② general(S3): 'in general(일반적으로)' 전치사구로 적절
✅ ③ difference(S4): 'makes a difference(변화를 만든다)'에 적절
✅ ④ services(S5): 제품과 '서비스'라는 병렬 구조에 적절
det.tip: leave는 '방치하다, 떠넘기다'의 뉘앙스. assign은 '공식적으로 배정하다'. 문맥상 녹색 소비자는 책임을 '떠넘기지 않겠다'는 것이므로 leave가 적합.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 열린 마음 — 내적 통제와 함께 녹색 소비자를 인도하는 특성
det.analysis:
✅ ② open-mindedness(열린 마음): 'guided by their internal control and __________'에서 내적 통제와 병렬로 녹색 소비자를 인도하는 특성.
❌ ① competitiveness(경쟁심): 환경 보호 맥락과 무관
❌ ③ indifference(무관심): 적극적인 녹색 소비자와 정반대
❌ ④ profitability(수익성): 이익 추구는 본문의 환경 보호 논지와 상반
det.tip: open-mindedness(열린 마음)는 internal control과 함께 녹색 소비자의 내면적 특성을 구성한다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 일자리 기회 — 기업이 녹색 소비 분야에서 창출하는 것
det.analysis:
✅ ④ job opportunities(일자리 기회): 'by creating __________ in green consumption'에서 기업이 녹색 소비 분야에서 '일자리 기회'를 창출한다는 원문에 부합.
❌ ① tax incentives(세금 혜택): 본문에 세금 관련 내용 없음
❌ ② legal regulations(법적 규제): 본문에 규제 관련 내용 없음
❌ ③ profit margins(이윤폭): 이윤 추구 문맥이 아님
det.tip: creating job opportunities in green consumption(녹색 소비 분야에서 일자리 기회를 창출하다)는 기업의 환경적 기여를 보여준다.

det.korean: ③ 원문 S4: an individual's consumption makes a difference in environmental issues
det.analysis:
❌ ① 원문은 '맡기지 않는다(would not leave)'고 함 (반대)
❌ ② 원문은 기업이 비용을 '결합한다(combine)'고 함 (반대)
✅ ③ 원문 4문장과 일치
❌ ④ 원문은 친환경 제품을 '선호한다(prefer)'고 함 (반대)
det.tip: makes a difference(변화를 만든다)는 녹색 소비자의 핵심 신념이다.

det.analysis:
❌ ① 원문은 '내적 통제(internal control)'에 의해 인도된다고 함. 외부 기관의 지시가 아님 ←정답
✅ ② 원문 3문장과 일치: a vital role in fighting to protect environment
✅ ③ 원문 6문장과 일치: provide green management and green marketing practices
✅ ④ 원문 7문장과 일치: targeting sustainability by using their purchasing power
det.tip: internal control(내적 통제)은 녹색 소비자가 자발적으로 행동함을 의미한다.

questions.passage: Green consumers, compared with non-green consumers, prefer purchasing environmentally-friendly products over the standard alternatives available. Green consumers believe that <u>They</u> are guided by their internal control and open-mindedness, so they would not leave the responsibilities of protecting the environment to governments, business communities, environmentalists or scientists. Green consumers are ordinary people thinking that business operations have a vital role in fighting to protect environment in general. Moreover, these consumers believe that an individual's consumption makes a difference in environmental issues. When green consumers demand products and services, firms combine environmental and social costs of their production and consumption. They also provide green management and green marketing practices by creating job opportunities in green consumption. Therefore, it could be said that green consumers are individuals targeting sustainability by using their purchasing power.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 They가 가리키는 것은?

det.analysis:

본문 6문장: '<u>They</u> also provide green management and green marketing practices...'
They는 바로 앞 문장의 주어 firms를 지칭한다.

❌ ① 환경 운동가들: 본문에서 주체로 등장하지 않음
